disclosure: All original v2 gates, the completed RoboTwin pairs03-09, V2-A008 prompt-sensitivity failure, and V2-A015 results were known before this prospective plan was frozen. No result is represented as hidden preregistration.
non_retroactivity: This amendment neither modifies v2 nor permits rerunning valid v2/V2-A015 cells. Preserved cells may be referenced only under their recorded runtime-identity and comparison boundaries.

A_direct_replication.gate: Each model/arena passes independent fixture, raw-output, exact-repeat, and LEFT/RIGHT prompt-sensitivity gates before its behavioral cells release.
A_direct_replication.randomization: Registered cell order is randomized within arena while preserving matched LEFT/RIGHT execution provenance.

B_confound_ablation.unit: A contemporaneous matched control/intervention pair at the same registered model, seed, reset, prompt, action contract, and execution lane.
B_confound_ablation.one_factor_rule: Each ablation changes exactly one named factor; checkpoint, source/runtime identity, prompt bytes, reset, scorer, controller, horizon, and retention contract remain fixed.
B_confound_ablation.randomization: Control/intervention order is randomized at the matched-pair level before any arm request. A paired allocation manifest and seed list are immutable before inference.
B_confound_ablation.denominator: Each intervention configuration has its own denominator. Existing v2/V2-A015 baselines are preserved descriptive comparators and are never overwritten or silently used as contemporaneous controls.
required_preflight: model-blind fixture calibration freezes numeric coordinates and margins in a new amendment
B_confound_ablation.claim_boundary: Report exact paired transitions and continuous-margin effects descriptively. Do not make powered, general, or per-failure causal claims unless a future amendment supplies a power calculation and inferential threshold.

C_four_phrasings.randomization: The four exact v2 wording forms use the registry's 20 shared DROID matched seeds and hash-pinned joint prompt-form/LEFT/RIGHT randomization.
C_four_phrasings.gate: The direct-command control for that exact model/runtime must be released, and every wording must pass byte-hash, exact-repeat, and prompt-only sensitivity checks before behavioral execution.
C_four_phrasings.semantic_boundary: The registry freezes the exact v2 rendered DROID strings. No oracle, coach, prompt switching, or progress-conditioned instruction is permitted.
C_four_phrasings.pi0_fast_boundary: V2-A008 remains failed and unreleased. Its current-stack outcome cannot authorize this block; a v3 model-specific release gate is still required.

D_16_rollout_stochastic_block.replication_definition: Sixteen shared sampling-seed indices are nested within every released Phase-A registered condition only when the runtime exposes a real effective stochastic seed.
D_16_rollout_stochastic_block.gate: The registry's exact-runtime Phase-A release and effective-seed probe must pass before its sixteen rollout block releases.
D_16_rollout_stochastic_block.analysis_boundary: The sixteen observations estimate within-condition policy-sampling variability. They are not independent scenes and are analyzed as nested stochastic blocks.

arena_boundary: DROID/RoboLab and RoboTwin raw results are never pooled.
stop_rule: No phase releases another phase. A failed gate preserves its evidence, leaves its behavioral cells unrun, and requires a new disclosed amendment for any alternative path.
